say:1:1520605001:1.text: Dad, this is bread! If you don't believe me, I'll take a bite right now...
say:1:1520605001:1.source_cn: 爸爸，你们到底在说什么啊？这明明就是面包啊！你们不信的...

choice_prompt:2:1520605001.text: Dad, this is bread! If you don't believe me, I'll take a bite right now...
choice_prompt:2:1520605001.source_cn: 爸爸，你们到底在说什么啊？这明明就是面包啊！你们不信的话，我现在就吃一口试试——

say:4:1520605002:0.text: Without hesitation, Gala follows your command and snatches the rock from Roman's hand...
say:4:1520605002:0.source_cn: 加拉毫不犹豫地遵从了你的指令，上前直接夺走了罗姆手中的...

say:6:1520605003:0.text: Sarethiel above, it's... it's a Wildborn!! How did she get in here?!
say:6:1520605003:0.source_cn: ——丰饶神在上，是、是兽人！！她是怎么跑到这里来的？！

say:7:1520605004:1.text: I was only following Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s orders to take the rock. I won't hurt him.
say:7:1520605004:1.male: I was only following Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s orders to take the rock. I won't hurt him.
say:7:1520605004:1.female: I was only following Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s orders to take the rock. I won't hurt him.

say:8:1520605005:0.text: Get away from him! You furspawn are all the same!
say:8:1520605005:0.source_cn: 你们兽人都不是什么好东西！滚开！

say:11:1520605006:0.text: Wildborn? Where? I don't see one?!
say:11:1520605006:0.source_cn: 兽人？哪里有兽人？我没看到啊！

say:13:1520605007:0.text: Roman glances back and forth, trying to find the Wildborn his father mentioned. But his eyes pass right over Gala without a flicker of recognition.
say:13:1520605007:0.source_cn: 罗姆来回转头，试图寻找他父亲所说的兽人。但当他的目光掠...

say:14:1520605008:1.text: You notice his eyes are unfocused. Something is definitely wrong with him.
say:14:1520605008:1.source_cn: 你敏锐地察觉到，他的眼神有些涣散，状态似乎不太对劲。

say:15:1520605009:1.text: Just as you're about to ask, Roman's gaze suddenly freezes on you.
say:15:1520605009:1.source_cn: 正当你准备开口询问时，罗姆的视线忽然停住了——停在了你身上。

say:17:1520605010:1.text: You... why are you pointing a knife at me?
say:17:1520605010:1.source_cn: 你……你为什么拿刀对着我？
say:17:1520605010:1.male: You... why are you pointing a knife at me?
say:17:1520605010:1.female: You... why are you pointing a knife at me?

choice_prompt:18:1520605010.text: You... why are you pointing a knife at me?
choice_prompt:18:1520605010.source_cn: 你……你为什么拿刀对着我？
choice_prompt:18:1520605010.male: You... why are you pointing a knife at me?
choice_prompt:18:1520605010.female: You... why are you pointing a knife at me?

say:20:1520605011:1.text: Roman, what are you talking about...? He's not holding a knife.
say:20:1520605011:1.male: Roman, what are you talking about...? He's not holding a knife.
say:20:1520605011:1.female: Roman, what are you talking about...? She's not holding a knife.

say:21:1520605012:0.text: Yes he is, I can see it!
say:21:1520605012:0.male: Yes he is, I can see it!
say:21:1520605012:0.female: Yes he is, I can see it!

say:22:1520605013:0.text: He's threatening that little girl with a knife, that's why she stole my bread! He's a big meanie!
say:22:1520605013:0.male: He's threatening that little girl with a knife, that's why she stole my bread! He's a big meanie!
say:22:1520605013:0.female: She's threatening that little girl with a knife, that's why she stole my bread! She's a big meanie!

say:23:1520605014:1.text: I... I have to save her!
say:23:1520605014:1.source_cn: 我……我要救出那个可怜的姐姐！

say:25:1520605015:0.text: Before you can react, Roman rushes forward and grabs Gala's hand.
say:25:1520605015:0.source_cn: 没等你反应过来，罗姆已经冲到你们面前，一把抓住了加拉的手。

say:27:1520605016:1.text: Run, let's get out of here!

choice:18:1:2.text: Who? I don't have a knife?
choice:18:1:2.male: Who? I don't have a knife?
choice:18:1:2.female: Who? I don't have a knife?
